## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// An analytic clear-sky model (Preetham / Hosek-Wilkie family). SunDirection
// is the direction sunlight travels; Turbidity is atmospheric haze, roughly in
// [1, 10]; GroundAlbedo is the average ground reflectance feeding bounce
// light; Intensity is a dimensionless multiplier on the computed radiance.
type ProceduralSky
    implements IValue
{
    SunDirection: Direction3D;
    Turbidity: Number;
    GroundAlbedo: Color;
    Intensity: Number;
}

// A uniform, directionless fill light applied everywhere; the crudest ambient
// term.
type AmbientLight
    implements IValue
{
    Color: Color;
    Illuminance: Illuminance;
}

// A point probe capturing local incident light for re-lighting nearby objects.
// InfluenceRadius bounds the affected region in scene units; Intensity scales
// the captured radiance.
type LightProbe
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    InfluenceRadius: Number;
    Intensity: Number;
}

//==
// # Shadows, masking, and auxiliary light settings
//
// The per-light controls that accompany the emitters above without
// being emitters themselves: shadow-map rendering, layer masking, measured
// photometric profiles, and participating-media scattering. Distances and radii
// are unit-agnostic scene Numbers.

// Shadow-map rendering controls for one light. Resolution is the shadow map
// edge length in pixels. Bias and NormalBias offset depth comparisons along
// the view ray and surface normal to prevent acne. PenumbraSize scales
// soft-shadow width. CascadeCount splits a directional shadow into successive
// depth ranges (1 = no cascades). MaxDistance is the farthest shadowed
// distance in scene units. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shadow_mapping)
type ShadowSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Resolution: Integer;
    Bias: Number;
    NormalBias: Number;
    PenumbraSize: Number;
    CascadeCount: Integer;
    MaxDistance: Number;
}

// A bitmask selecting which render layers a light illuminates: bit i set means
// the light affects the RenderLayer with IIndex i (`scene3d.types.plato`). All bits set means
// all layers.
type LightLayerMask
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A reference to a measured IES photometric distribution profile, resolved by
// Name in the surrounding asset environment. Multiplier scales the profile's
// intensities (1 = as measured).
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Photometry_(optics).
type IesProfileReference
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Multiplier: Number;
}

// Participating-media scattering along a light's volume ("god rays").
// Anisotropy is the Henyey-Greenstein g in [-1, 1]: 0 is isotropic, positive
// scatters forward. MaxDistance bounds the ray march in scene units.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volumetric_lighting)
type VolumetricLightSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Enabled: Boolean;
    Intensity: Number;
    Anisotropy: Number;
    MaxDistance: Number;
}
```
